depConstraints.description: Strict layering: presentation may reach its own tier and application, the tier immediately below it, and nothing else.
depConstraints.remediation: Route the call through application rather than reaching past it, or move the collaborator up to the tier that is allowed to see it.

depConstraints.description: Strict layering: application may reach its own tier and domain, the tier immediately below it, and nothing else.
depConstraints.remediation: Route the call through domain rather than reaching past it, or move the collaborator up to the tier that is allowed to see it.

depConstraints.description: Strict layering: domain may reach its own tier and infrastructure, the tier immediately below it, and nothing else.
depConstraints.remediation: Route the call through infrastructure rather than reaching past it, or move the collaborator up to the tier that is allowed to see it.

depConstraints.description: Strict layering: infrastructure may reach its own tier and nothing beneath it, because there is nothing beneath it.
depConstraints.remediation: Nothing may be imported from an outer tier here; invert the dependency instead.

depConstraints.description: Relaxed layering: presentation may reach its own tier and every tier beneath it, at any depth.
depConstraints.remediation: An upward edge is the violation here; invert the dependency, or move the shared piece down to a tier both sides may see.

depConstraints.remediation: An upward edge is the violation here; invert the dependency, or move the shared piece down to a tier both sides may see.

depConstraints.remediation: An upward edge is the violation here; invert the dependency, or move the shared piece down to a tier both sides may see.
